subject.title: feat: add flexible multi-sidebar chat layout

question: Should the new per-session sidebar model preserve an existing user’s global split-ratio preference as its initial compatible layout, rather than intentionally resetting that preference on upgrade?
rationale: The branch introduces a new user-visible layout model while removing a shipped preference, so maintainers need to confirm the intended upgrade contract before choosing a migration or accepting a reset.

options.title: Preserve the existing preference
options.body: Convert or apply the prior split ratio when initializing a session layout, then persist the normalized new layout.

options.title: Accept a documented layout reset
options.body: Intentionally reset the old preference only if maintainers accept the upgrade behavior and request clear release or in-product communication.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer landing until the desired long-term layout and preference migration contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing preference
recommendation.body: Convert or apply the prior split ratio when initializing a session layout, then persist the normalized new layout.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current layout and persistence design, so they are the closest available routing candidate for the upgrade-contract decision.
